snippet.title: The Wizard Needs Food, Badly! - Kitchen Pitchin'
snippet.description:
Here's a gameplay clip from my side-project, "The Wizard Needs Food, Badly!", the original idea was that after SRB2, Eggman crash-landed in a desert and was starving. During Sonic's victory party, he got hit on the head and forgot how to jump (in line with the messageboard meme). He comes across this hungry fat man whom he thinks he's never met before in his life and feel he has to help. Journey across several levels as you learn again how to jump, find food, turn ovens off, and feed this poor fat man with a penchant for insults!

Ultimately this was never finished, as it was intended as a variety game, and implementing VERY different gameplay for each stage was just too much. It was also to be very cartoony and expressive, which would have required a lot of art, and the technology at the time just wasn't there.

This version does not feature Sonic & Eggman because it was used for a class project. I also debated changing it to an original-character game.

See if you can spot the MDK2 and Five Iron Frenzy references!

Voices by InstantSonic
